description: This PHP source file defines the HomePageDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to retrieve homepage and module default page records based on user roles and priorities, interacting with the database via query builders.

classes.name: HomePageDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for retrieving homepage and default module page data based on user roles and priorities within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getHomePagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves home page entries for specific user roles, ordered by priority and ID in descending order.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves default module page entries for specific user roles and a given module, ordered by module name and priority in descending order.
